Title: Tafea
Blurb: Tafea declares independence from the Anglo-French New Hebrides Condominium.

Title: Smallpox Eradication Programme
Blurb: Epidemiology and vaccination led to the eradication of smallpox in humans. In 1980 the World Health Organization, through its Smallpox Eradication Programme launched in 1966, declared smallpox eradicated - the first and only human disease eliminated globally.

Title: Tafea
Blurb: Tafea is overthrown by British forces and reincorporated into the Anglo-French New Hebrides Condominium.

Title: Vemerana
Blurb: The Republic of Vemerana declares independence from the Anglo-French New Hebrides Condominium.

Title: Peru
Blurb: The Peruvian Republic changes its name to the Republic of Peru.

Title: East Jerusalem
Blurb: Israel passes the Jerusalem Law, annexing East Jerusalem and expanding its capital of Jerusalem to encompass the annexed area. The United Nations Security Council declares the law null and void.

Title: Vemerana
Blurb: The Republic of Vemerana is overthrown by the forces of Vanuatu supported by those of Papua New Guinea and the Solomon Islands.

Title: Khuzestan
Blurb: Iraq invades Iran, capturing more than 15,000 square kilometres by December, much of which it occupies for almost two years.

Title: Saint Christopher, Nevis and Anguilla
Blurb: The United Kingdom divides the associated state of Saint Christopher, Nevis and Anguilla into Saint Christopher and Nevis and the Crown Colony of Anguilla. Basseterre remains and The Valley becomes their respective capitals.

Title: European Communities
Blurb: Greece joins the European Communities.

Title: HIV
Blurb: A new viral disease, called the Human Immunodeficiency Virus, or HIV, arose in Africa and subsequently killed millions of people throughout the world. HIV leads to a syndrome called Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome, or AIDS.
Place: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo

Title: Roncador, Serrana and Quita Sueno Banks
Blurb: The United States removes its claims over Roncador Bank, Serrana Bank, and Quita Sueno Bank, ending part of its territorial dispute with Colombia.

Title: Ciskei
Blurb: The Bantustan Republic of Ciskei is declared independent by South Africa. Bisho becomes the capital. No other country recognizes its independence, widely seen as part of the institution of apartheid.

Title: Polish People's Republic
Blurb: The 1981 Martial law in Poland: the government of the Polish People's Republic drastically restricted everyday life by introducing martial law and a military junta in an attempt to counter political opposition, in particular the Solidarity movement.

Title: Golan Heights
Blurb: Israel annexes the Golan Heights.

Title: Saudi-Iraqi Neutral Zone
Blurb: Iraq approves a treaty of 26 December with Saudi Arabia to partition the Neutral Zone between the two. The actual division of the territory occurs thereafter, though the new border is made public only in June 1991.

Title: Canada
Blurb: Canada becomes a fully sovereign state with the promulgation of the Canada Act, eliminating all remaining powers in the country of the Parliament of the United Kingdom.

Title: Falkland Islands
Blurb: Argentina conquers the Falkland Islands from the United Kingdom, renaming the territory Islas Malvinas and the capital from Stanley to Puerto Argentino during a two-month-long occupation.

Title: Harare
Blurb: Zimbabwe changes the name of its capital from Salisbury to Harare.

Title: South Georgia
Blurb: The United Kingdom reconquers South Georgia from Argentina.

Title: Sinai Peninsula
Blurb: Israel completes the sixth and final step of withdrawal, begun on 25 May 1979, from the remaining territory it occupied in the Sinai Peninsula, fulfilling the terms of its March 1979 peace treaty with Egypt.

Title: Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte
Blurb: Sri Lanka moves its capital from Colombo to Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte.

Title: Spain
Blurb: Spain joins the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in the alliance's third enlargement.

Title: Southern Thule
Blurb: The United Kingdom reconquers Southern Thule in the South Sandwich Islands from Argentina.

Title: Khuzestan
Blurb: Iraqi forces are completely expelled from Iran amidst the ongoing Iran-Iraq War.

Title: Rwenzururu
Blurb: The unrecognized Kingdom of Rwenzururu disbands and surrenders to Uganda as part of an agreement promising the region a degree of local autonomy, eventually leading to its revival as a subnational kingdom.

Title: British Dependent Territories
Blurb: The United Kingdom changes the title of its Crown colonies and self-governing colonies to that of British Dependent Territories.

Title: Yamoussoukro
Blurb: Ivory Coast moves its capital from Abidjan to Yamoussoukro.

Title: Southern Sudan Autonomous Region
Blurb: The Southern Sudan Autonomous Region is abolished in Sudan.

Title: Tokelau
Blurb: The United States removes its claims over Atafu, Fakaofo, and Nukunono, ending part of its territorial dispute with Tokelau.

Title: Cook Islands
Blurb: The United States removes its claims over Pukapuka, Manihiki, Penrhyn, and Rakahanga, ending its territorial dispute with the Cook Islands.

Title: Saint Kitts and Nevis
Blurb: The associated state of Saint Christopher and Nevis gains independence from the United Kingdom as the Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis. Basseterre remains the capital.

Title: Kiribati
Blurb: The United States removes its claims over Birnie, Canton, Caroline, Christmas, Enderbury, Flint, Gardner, Hull, Malden, McKean, Phoenix, Starbuck, Sydney, and Vostok Islands, ending its territorial dispute with Kiribati.

Title: Tuvalu
Blurb: The United States removes its claims over Funafuti, Niulakita, Nukufetau, and Nukulaelae, ending its territorial dispute with Tuvalu.

Title: Northern Cyprus
Blurb: The Turkish Federated State of Cyprus declares independence from Cyprus as the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus. North Nicosia remains the capital. Only Turkey, which occupies Northern Cyprus, recognizes it.

Title: Brunei
Blurb: Brunei joins ASEAN as the association's sixth member state.

Title: Cameroon
Blurb: The United Republic of Cameroon changes its name to the Republic of Cameroon.

Title: Burkina Faso
Blurb: The Republic of Upper Volta changes its name to Burkina Faso.

Title: Beagle Channel
Blurb: A treaty, approved in Argentina by referendum, resolves the Beagle conflict by awarding the disputed Picton, Lennox and Nueva Islands to Chile and most of the adjacent maritime territory to Argentina. It also resolves the question of the eastern mouth of the Strait of Magellan.

Title: Southern Lebanon
Blurb: Israel withdraws from other territory it had captured in Lebanon since 1982 to a self-declared security zone of formal occupation covering 850 square kilometres of southern Lebanon.

Title: Saint Pierre and Miquelon
Blurb: France restores autonomous government to the Overseas Department of Saint Pierre and Miquelon, reorganizing it as the Territorial Collectivity of Saint Pierre and Miquelon.

Title: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Blurb: The United Kingdom detaches the Falkland Islands Dependencies from the Falkland Islands as the separate territory of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands. King Edward Point becomes the capital.

Title: Sudan
Blurb: The Democratic Republic of the Sudan changes its name to the Republic of the Sudan.

Title: Cote d'Ivoire
Blurb: The Republic of Ivory Coast changes its official English name to the Republic of Cote d'Ivoire.

Title: European Communities
Blurb: Portugal and Spain join the European Communities.

Title: Australia
Blurb: Australia becomes a fully sovereign state with the promulgation of the Australia Act, eliminating all remaining powers in the country of the Parliament of the United Kingdom.

Title: Libya
Blurb: The Socialist People's Libyan Arab Jamahiriya changes its name to the Great Socialist People's Libyan Arab Jamahiriya.

Title: Thule Air Base
Blurb: The United States returns almost half of its concession at Thule Air Base to the jurisdiction of Greenland and Denmark.

Title: Marshall Islands
Blurb: The Republic of the Marshall Islands withdraws from the US-administered United Nations Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands and becomes independent in free association with the United States. Majuro remains the capital.

Title: Federated States of Micronesia
Blurb: The Federated States of Micronesia withdraws from the US-administered United Nations Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands and becomes independent in free association with the United States. Kolonia remains the capital.

Title: Northern Mariana Islands
Blurb: The Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands withdraws from the US-administered United Nations Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands and becomes an insular area of the United States. Saipan remains the capital.

Title: New Zealand
Blurb: New Zealand becomes a fully sovereign state with the promulgation of the Constitution Act, eliminating all remaining powers in the country of the Parliament of the United Kingdom.

Title: Ethiopia
Blurb: The Provisional Military Government of Socialist Ethiopia (Derg) changes its name to the People's Democratic Republic of Ethiopia.

Title: Fiji
Blurb: Following a coup, the Dominion of Fiji changes its name to the Republic of Fiji and severs all ties to the British monarchy as a Commonwealth realm. Fiji is deemed to have temporarily left the Commonwealth as a result.

Title: Afghanistan
Blurb: The Democratic Republic of Afghanistan changes its name to the Republic of Afghanistan.

Title: Iraqi Kurdistan
Blurb: Iran withdraws from Iraqi Kurdistan after having been evicted from territory it occupied further south, as Iraq returns to the offensive and once more invades Iran, precipitating a ceasefire in the Iran-Iraq War on 20 August.

Title: Al-Qaeda
Blurb: 1988 - Al-Qaeda, a network of Islamic extremists, is founded among Arab members of the Afghan mujahideen. It engages in a number of terror attacks throughout the 1990s, leading up to the September 11 attacks in 2001.

Title: Burma
Blurb: The Socialist Republic of the Union of Burma changes its name to the Union of Burma, with the SLORC junta's suspension of the 1974 Constitution.

Title: Eastern and Central Europe
Blurb: The revolutions of 1989 release Eastern and Central Europe from Soviet control. Soon after, the Soviet Union, Czechoslovakia and Yugoslavia dissolve - the last violently over several years - into successor states, many riven by ethnic nationalism.

Title: Afghanistan
Blurb: The Soviet Union completely withdraws its forces from Afghanistan, ending a nine-year-long occupation.

Title: State of Cambodia
Blurb: The People's Republic of Kampuchea changes its name to the State of Cambodia.

Title: Tiananmen Square
Blurb: The Tiananmen Square protests, demonstrations in and near Tiananmen Square in Beijing led mainly by students and intellectuals, end with hundreds of protesters killed and thousands wounded, in a year that saw communist governments collapse worldwide.

Title: Myanmar
Blurb: The Union of Burma changes its name to the Union of Myanmar. The official English name of its capital is changed from Rangoon to Yangon.

Title: Cambodia
Blurb: Vietnam completely withdraws its forces from Cambodia, ending a more than ten-year-long occupation.

Title: Senegambia Confederation
Blurb: The Senegambia Confederation between Senegal and The Gambia is dissolved.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: The Hungarian People's Republic changes its name to the Hungarian Republic.

Title: Palikir
Blurb: The Federated States of Micronesia moves its capital from Kolonia to Palikir.

Title: Panama
Blurb: The United States invades Panama after a declaration of war by Panama's general assembly.

Title: Romania
Blurb: Following the Romanian Revolution, the Socialist Republic of Romania changes its name to Romania.

Title: Poland
Blurb: The Polish People's Republic changes its name to the Republic of Poland.

Title: Karki
Blurb: Armenian forces conquer Karki, an exclave of the Azerbaijan SSR. It remains Azerbaijani territory only de jure.

Title: Panama
Blurb: The United States invasion of Panama ends after the surrender of President Manuel Noriega several weeks earlier.

Title: Benin
Blurb: The People's Republic of Benin changes its name to the Republic of Benin.

Title: Slovenia
Blurb: The Socialist Republic of Slovenia changes its name to the Republic of Slovenia.

Title: Valparaiso
Blurb: Chile moves its legislative capital from Santiago to Valparaiso. Santiago remains the administrative capital.

Title: Estonia
Blurb: Following grassroots elections, the Estonian SSR declares Soviet rule in Estonia illegal from the moment of establishment and announces a transitional period to restore the independence of the Republic of Estonia from the Soviet Union.

Title: Czech and Slovak Federative Republic
Blurb: The Czechoslovak Socialist Republic changes its name to the Czech and Slovak Federative Republic.

Title: Hubble Space Telescope
Blurb: The Hubble Space Telescope, launched in 1990, greatly expanded humanity's understanding of the Universe and brought brilliant images to TV and computer screens around the world.
Place: Kennedy Space Center, Florida, United States

Title: Latvia
Blurb: Following democratic elections, the Latvian Soviet Socialist Republic declares independence from the Soviet Union as the restored Republic of Latvia, while also announcing a transitional period to achieve independence.

Title: Estonia
Blurb: The Estonian Soviet Socialist Republic changes its name to the Republic of Estonia.

Title: Republic of Bougainville
Blurb: The Republic of Bougainville declares independence from Papua New Guinea. Arawa becomes the capital.

Title: Moldova
Blurb: The Moldavian Soviet Socialist Republic changes its name to the Soviet Socialist Republic of Moldova.

Title: Fiji
Blurb: The Republic of Fiji changes its name to the Sovereign Democratic Republic of Fiji.

Title: Kuwait
Blurb: Iraq invades Kuwait, beginning a seven-month-long occupation.

Title: Kuwait
Blurb: The State of Kuwait changes its name to the Republic of Kuwait as a Provisional Government is installed by Iraq.

Title: Gagauz Republic
Blurb: The Gagauz Republic is declared as a republic within the Soviet Union separate from the Soviet Socialist Republic of Moldova. Comrat becomes the capital. It remains a de facto independent state following the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

Title: Iran
Blurb: Iraq completely withdraws its forces from the territory of Iran occupied during the last weeks of the Iran-Iraq War, returning to the internationally recognized borders established by the 1975 Algiers Agreement.

Title: Armenia
Blurb: The Armenian Soviet Socialist Republic secedes from the Soviet Union as the Republic of Armenia. Yerevan remains the capital.

Title: Kuwait
Blurb: Iraq annexes the Republic of Kuwait as the Kuwait Governorate and Saddamiyat al-Mitla' District.

Title: Transnistria
Blurb: The Pridnestrovian Moldavian Soviet Socialist Republic declares independence from the Soviet Socialist Republic of Moldova as a separate republic within the Soviet Union. Tiraspol becomes the capital.

Title: South Ossetia
Blurb: The South Ossetian Autonomous Oblast changes its name to the South Ossetian Soviet Democratic Republic and declares its independence from the Georgian SSR inside the Soviet Union. Tskhinvali becomes the capital.

Title: East Germany
Blurb: East Germany leaves the Warsaw Pact in preparation for German reunification, with Soviet consent.

Title: Germany
Blurb: East Germany and West Germany were reunified in 1990.

Title: Kyrgyzstan
Blurb: The Kirghiz Soviet Socialist Republic changes its name to the Socialist Republic of Kyrgyzstan.

Title: Bulgaria
Blurb: The People's Republic of Bulgaria changes its name to the Republic of Bulgaria.

Title: Georgia
Blurb: The Georgian Soviet Socialist Republic changes its name to the Republic of Georgia.

Title: South Ossetia
Blurb: The South Ossetian Soviet Democratic Republic changes its name to the South Ossetian Soviet Republic.

Title: Mozambique
Blurb: The People's Republic of Mozambique changes its name to the Republic of Mozambique.

Title: Kyrgyzstan
Blurb: The Socialist Republic of Kyrgyzstan changes its name to the Republic of Kyrgyzstan.

Title: Croatia
Blurb: The Socialist Republic of Croatia changes its name to the Republic of Croatia.

Title: Soviet Union
Blurb: After the Soviet Union collapsed under internal pressure in 1991, most of the communist governments it had supported were dismantled - with the notable exceptions of China, North Korea, Cuba, Vietnam and Laos - followed by hard transitions to market economies.

Title: Lithuania
Blurb: The forces of the Soviet Union withdraw from Lithuania's cities following a failed attempt to overthrow the unrecognized Republic of Lithuania.

Title: Azerbaijan
Blurb: The Azerbaijan Soviet Socialist Republic changes its name to the Republic of Azerbaijan.

Title: Bishkek
Blurb: The Republic of Kyrgyzstan changes the name of its capital from Frunze to Bishkek.

Title: Lithuania
Blurb: Iceland becomes the first UN member state to recognize the independence of a Republic of the Soviet Union, Lithuania, when its parliament votes that the 1940 Soviet annexation is legally void. Other states soon follow.

Title: Germany
Blurb: Germany becomes fully sovereign, as the Four Powers (France, the Soviet Union, United Kingdom, and United States) renounce their rights in the country dating from the post-war occupation in the Two Plus Four Agreement.

Title: Georgia
Blurb: The Republic of Georgia secedes from the Soviet Union following a referendum. Tbilisi remains the capital.

Title: Albania
Blurb: The People's Socialist Republic of Albania changes its name to the Republic of Albania.

Title: Republic of China
Blurb: The Republic of China ends the state of rebellion and war with the People's Republic of China. The constitution is restored with amendments demarcating the Free Area and the Mainland Area, recognising Communist control of the latter without diplomatic ties.

Title: South Ossetia
Blurb: The Assembly of the South Ossetian Soviet Republic votes to return to the status of a South Ossetian Autonomous Oblast; the Supreme Council of Georgia had dissolved the autonomous region on 10 December.

Title: Somaliland
Blurb: The Republic of Somaliland declares independence from Somalia. Hargeisa becomes the capital. All other countries continue to officially recognize Somaliland as part of Somalia.

Title: Moldova
Blurb: The Soviet Socialist Republic of Moldova changes its name to the Republic of Moldova.

Title: Eritrea
Blurb: The State of Eritrea gains de facto independence from the People's Democratic Republic of Ethiopia following a decades-long War of Independence.

Title: Macedonia
Blurb: The Socialist Republic of Macedonia changes its name to the Republic of Macedonia.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: The Soviet Union completely withdraws its forces from Hungary, ending an occupation begun in 1944.

Title: Czechoslovakia
Blurb: The Soviet Union completely withdraws its forces from Czechoslovakia, ending an occupation begun in 1968.

Title: Santa Fe de Bogota
Blurb: Colombia changes the name of its capital from Bogota, Distrito Capital to Santa Fe de Bogota with the promulgation of a new constitution.

Title: Somalia
Blurb: The Somali Republic supersedes the Somali Democratic Republic, as rebel factions agree to restore the Constitution of 1960. Mogadishu remains the capital, though its authority is limited amidst ongoing civil war.

Title: Ethiopia
Blurb: Following the victory of the EPRDF in the civil war, Ethiopia supersedes the People's Democratic Republic of Ethiopia. Addis Ababa remains the capital.

Title: Montenegro
Blurb: The Socialist Republic of Montenegro changes its name to the Republic of Montenegro.

Title: Soviet Union
Blurb: 1991 Soviet coup attempt, a failed attempt by hardliners of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union (CPSU) to forcibly seize control of the country from Mikhail Gorbachev, who was Soviet President and General Secretary of the CPSU at the time.

Title: Estonia
Blurb: In response to the Soviet coup d'etat attempt, the Republic of Estonia announces the end of the transitional period and declares complete independence restored from the Soviet Union. Tallinn remains the capital.

Title: Latvia
Blurb: In response to the Soviet coup d'etat attempt, the Republic of Latvia announces the end of the transitional period and declares complete independence restored from the Soviet Union. Riga remains the capital.

Title: Tajikistan
Blurb: The Tajik Soviet Socialist Republic changes its name to the Republic of Tajikistan.

Title: South Ossetia
Blurb: The South Ossetian Autonomous Oblast changes its name to the Republic of South Ossetia and annuls the law of 4 May, reverting to the status of independence from Georgia within the Soviet Union.

Title: Nagorno-Karabakh Republic
Blurb: The Nagorno-Karabakh Autonomous Oblast and Shahumyan district councils jointly declare independence from Azerbaijan as the Nagorno-Karabakh Republic within the Soviet Union. Stepanakert becomes the capital.

Title: Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania
Blurb: The first meeting of the State Council of the Soviet Union recognizes the independence of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.

Title: Western Sahara
Blurb: A ceasefire is imposed in the war in Western Sahara, with Morocco controlling 80% of the territory within a defensive wall and the Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic governing the remaining Free Zone from Tifariti.

Title: Macedonia
Blurb: The Republic of Macedonia secedes from Yugoslavia. Skopje remains the capital.

Title: Belarus
Blurb: The Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic changes its name to the Republic of Belarus.

Title: Chechen Republic
Blurb: The Chechen Republic declares independence from the Soviet Union after elections. Grozny becomes the capital. The Russian SFSR declares the election illegal the next day.

Title: Transnistria
Blurb: The Pridnestrovian Moldavian Soviet Socialist Republic changes its name to the Pridnestrovian Moldavian Republic (Transnistria).

Title: Ukraine
Blurb: The Russian SFSR recognizes the independence of Ukraine the day after it is affirmed by a referendum.

Title: Commonwealth of Independent States
Blurb: The Russian SFSR, the Republic of Belarus, and Ukraine form the Commonwealth of Independent States as a successor organization to the Soviet Union.

Title: Kazakhstan
Blurb: The Kazakh Soviet Socialist Republic changes its name to the Republic of Kazakhstan.

Title: Abuja
Blurb: Nigeria moves its capital from Lagos to Abuja.

Title: South Ossetia
Blurb: The Republic of South Ossetia declares independence from the Soviet Union. Tskhinvali remains the capital. Georgia continues to claim South Ossetia as part of its own territory.

Title: Russian Federation
Blurb: The Russian Federation supersedes both the Soviet Union and the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. Moscow remains the capital.

Title: Iraq
Blurb: The Iraqi Republic changes its name to the Republic of Iraq.

Title: Nagorno-Karabakh Republic
Blurb: The Nagorno-Karabakh Republic declares its complete independence following a referendum. Azerbaijan, which abolished the Nagorno-Karabakh Autonomous Oblast on 26 November, continues to claim its territory in full.

Title: Mongolia
Blurb: The Mongolian People's Republic changes its name to Mongolia upon the promulgation of a new constitution.

Title: Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia
Blurb: The Serbian Autonomous Oblast of Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia and the Serbian Autonomous Oblast of Western Slavonia join the Republic of Serbian Krajina.

Title: Chechen Republic of Ichkeria
Blurb: The Chechen Republic changes its name to the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria upon the promulgation of a new constitution.

Title: Mauritius
Blurb: Mauritius changes its name to the Republic of Mauritius and severs all ties to the British monarchy as a Commonwealth realm, but remains part of the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Cambodia
Blurb: The State of Cambodia cedes all government powers to the United Nations Transitional Authority in Cambodia tasked with organizing constituent assembly elections, in fulfillment of the 1991 Paris Peace Agreements.

Title: Republic of the Congo
Blurb: The People's Republic of the Congo changes its name to the Republic of the Congo following the promulgation of a new constitution by referendum.

Title: Bosnia and Herzegovina
Blurb: Bosnian War, international armed conflict that took place in Bosnia and Herzegovina between 1992 and 1995.

Title: Serbian Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina
Blurb: The Serbian Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina declares independence from the Socialist Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Pale becomes the capital.

Title: Bosnia and Herzegovina
Blurb: The Socialist Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina changes its name to the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Title: Islamic State of Afghanistan
Blurb: An accord between the Mujahideen and Afghan Army factions ends the civil war and creates the Islamic State of Afghanistan, superseding the Republic of Afghanistan. The new state immediately plunges into a new civil war.

Title: Barxudarli and Sofulu
Blurb: Armenia conquers Barxudarli and Sofulu, two exclaves of Azerbaijan. They remain Azerbaijani territory only de jure.

Title: Collective Security Treaty
Blurb: The Collective Security Treaty is signed by six post-Soviet states: Russia, Armenia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan.

Title: Yukhari Askipara
Blurb: Armenia conquers Yukhari Askipara, an exclave of Azerbaijan. It remains Azerbaijani territory only de jure.

Title: South Ossetia
Blurb: A ceasefire is imposed in the war between the unrecognized Republic of South Ossetia and Georgia, with Georgia losing control of over 60% of the former South Ossetian Autonomous Oblast which it continues to claim in full.

Title: Transnistria
Blurb: A ceasefire is imposed in the war between the unrecognized Transnistria and Moldova, with Moldova losing control of Bender and most of the left bank of the Dniester both of which it continues to claim in full.

Title: Abkhazia
Blurb: The Abkhaz faction of the Abkhazia Supreme Soviet effectively declares independence from Georgia by reinstating the 1925 constitution, precipitating a Georgian military response and the outbreak of war.

Title: Artsvashen
Blurb: Azerbaijan conquers Artsvashen, an exclave of Armenia. It remains Armenian territory only de jure.

Title: Republika Srpska
Blurb: The Serbian Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina changes its name to Republika Srpska.

Title: Angola
Blurb: The People's Republic of Angola changes its name to the Republic of Angola with the enactment of constitutional revisions.

Title: Mongolia
Blurb: Russia completely withdraws its forces from Mongolia, ending its military presence in the country since 1967.

Title: Madagascar
Blurb: The Democratic Republic of Madagascar changes its name to the Republic of Madagascar upon the promulgation of a new constitution.

Title: Republic of Kosova
Blurb: The Republic of Kosova declares independence from Yugoslavia, though it only ever exercises partial control over most of the territory it claims and receives no international recognition. Pristina is the declared capital.

Title: Khuriya Muriya Islands
Blurb: Oman and Yemen resolve their border dispute, in particular over the Khuriya Muriya Islands which are confirmed as part of the territory of Oman.

Title: Collective Security Treaty
Blurb: Azerbaijan, Belarus, and Georgia join the Collective Security Treaty.

Title: Czech Republic and Slovakia
Blurb: The Czech Republic and the Slovak Republic gain full independence with the dissolution of the Czech and Slovak Federative Republic. Prague and Bratislava remain the respective capitals.

Title: Almaty
Blurb: Kazakhstan changes the name of its capital from Alma-Ata to Almaty.

Title: Arawa
Blurb: Papua New Guinea reconquers Arawa, the capital of the Republic of Bougainville. The Bougainville Revolutionary Army wages an insurgency until the 1997-98 agreements leading to a 2019 independence referendum.

Title: Macedonia
Blurb: The Republic of Macedonia becomes a member state of the United Nations as the former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia due to Greece's objection to its official name.

Title: Kyrgyz Republic
Blurb: The Republic of Kyrgyzstan changes its name to the Kyrgyz Republic.

Title: Seychelles
Blurb: The Republic of the Seychelles changes its name to the Republic of Seychelles.

Title: Croatian Republic of Herzeg-Bosnia
Blurb: The Croatian Community of Herzeg-Bosnia declares itself the Croatian Republic of Herzeg-Bosnia with the intention of forcing the Owen-Stoltenberg plan upon Bosnia and Herzegovina. Mostar becomes the capital.

Title: Poland
Blurb: Russia completely withdraws its forces from Poland, ending its military presence in the country since World War II.

Title: Kingdom of Cambodia
Blurb: With the promulgation of a new constitution by the Constituent Assembly elected in May, the United Nations Transitional Authority in Cambodia cedes its authority to the restored Kingdom of Cambodia.

Title: Sukhumi
Blurb: The forces of Russia and the unrecognized Republic of Abkhazia conquer the Abkhazian capital of Sukhumi from Georgia, which continues to claim the entire territory of the Autonomous Republic of Abkhazia.

Title: European Union
Blurb: The European Union is established between the twelve members of the European Communities: Belgium, Denmark, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Portugal, Spain, and the United Kingdom.

Title: Walvis Bay
Blurb: South Africa transfers Walvis Bay and the Penguin Islands to Namibia.

Title: Baikonur Cosmodrome
Blurb: Kazakhstan leases Baikonur Cosmodrome to Russia for twenty years, with automatic extension absent objections by either party.

Title: Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
Blurb: In a ceasefire agreement, the government-controlled territories of the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina and the Croatian Republic of Herzeg-Bosnia combine to form the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Title: Collective Security Treaty Organization
Blurb: The Collective Security Treaty takes effect, creating the Collective Security Treaty Organization military alliance.

Title: Rwanda
Blurb: The 1994 Rwandan genocide: over a span of around 100 days, members of the Tutsi ethnic group, as well as some moderate Hutu and Twa, were systematically killed by Hutu militias.

Title: Bophuthatswana, Ciskei, Transkei and Venda
Blurb: The nominally independent republics of Bophuthatswana, Ciskei, Transkei and Venda are reincorporated back into South Africa.

Title: Palestinian National Authority
Blurb: An agreement between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization, implementing the Oslo I Accord, creates the Palestinian National Authority.

Title: Aouzou Strip
Blurb: Libya completely withdraws its forces from the Aouzou Strip in northern Chad after a 21-year occupation, implementing a 3 February ICJ verdict which upheld Chad's sovereignty over the territory.

Title: Nagorno-Karabakh
Blurb: A ceasefire is imposed in the First Nagorno-Karabakh War with the forces of the unrecognized Nagorno-Karabakh Republic, supported by Armenia, occupying more than 13% of the internationally recognized territory of Azerbaijan.

Title: Democratic Republic of Yemen
Blurb: Yemeni government forces reconquer the Democratic Republic of Yemen.

Title: Eastern Germany
Blurb: Russia completely withdraws its forces from eastern Germany, ending an occupation begun in 1945.

Title: Laguna del Desierto
Blurb: Argentina is awarded almost all of Laguna del Desierto surrounding territory, also claimed by Chile, following international arbitration.

Title: Kandahar
Blurb: The Taliban conquers Kandahar, the first city to fall under the control of the militant group in Afghanistan.

Title: Kuwait
Blurb: Iraq recognizes the independence and territorial integrity of Kuwait following a new war scare on their borders.

Title: European Union
Blurb: Three more states join the European Union: Austria, Finland, and Sweden.

Title: Kiribati
Blurb: The International Date Line is moved around Kiribati.

Title: Gagauzia
Blurb: The self-proclaimed Gagauz Republic is reintegrated into Moldova as the Autonomous Territorial Unit of Gagauzia.

Title: Western Slavonia
Blurb: Croatian forces reconquer the Western Slavonia region of Serbian Krajina.

Title: Oman-Saudi border
Blurb: Oman and Saudi Arabia finalize the demarcation of their previously undefined border.

Title: Republic of Western Bosnia
Blurb: The Autonomous Province of Western Bosnia changes its name to the Republic of Western Bosnia.

Title: Vietnam
Blurb: Vietnam joins ASEAN as the association's seventh member state.

Title: Republic of Western Bosnia
Blurb: The Republic of Western Bosnia is conquered by the forces of Bosnia and Herzegovina supported by Croatia.

Title: Serbian Krajina
Blurb: Croatian and Bosnian forces reconquer most of Serbian Krajina.

Title: Georgia
Blurb: The Republic of Georgia changes its name to Georgia.

Title: West Bank and Gaza Strip
Blurb: The Oslo II Accord begins the transfer of land to the Palestinian Authority. All of the Gaza Strip and 18% of the West Bank is eventually transferred to full Palestinian control, and 22% to joint Israeli-Palestinian control.

Title: Kyiv
Blurb: Ukraine officially changes the English name of its capital from Kiev to Kyiv.

Title: Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia
Blurb: Croatia and the remaining portion of Serbian Krajina in Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Syrmia reach an agreement to reincorporate the region into Croatia through a transitional United Nations protectorate.

Title: Bosnia and Herzegovina
Blurb: The Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina and Republika Srpska unite to form Bosnia and Herzegovina, superseding the Republic of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Sarajevo remains the capital.

Title: Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium
Blurb: The United Nations Transitional Administration for Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium is established in the remaining territory of the former Serbian Krajina in order to reintegrate the region into Croatia.

Title: Dodoma
Blurb: Tanzania moves its capital from Dar es Salaam to Dodoma.

Title: Dolly the sheep
Blurb: Techniques developed after the determination of the structure of DNA culminated in cloning the first mammal in 1996.

Title: Mazar-i-Sharif
Blurb: The Islamic State of Afghanistan moves its de facto capital to Mazar-i-Sharif following the evacuation of Kabul.

Title: Dzokhar-Ghala
Blurb: The Chechen Republic of Ichkeria changes the name of its capital from Grozny to Dzokhar-Ghala.

Title: Democratic Republic of the Congo
Blurb: The Republic of Zaire changes its name back to the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Title: Taloqan
Blurb: The Islamic State of Afghanistan moves its capital from Mazar-i-Sharif to Taloqan, as Mazar-i-Sharif becomes a battlefield in the war against the Taliban.

Title: Sevastopol
Blurb: Ukraine formally agrees to lease naval facilities in Sevastopol to Russia for twenty years, until 2017.

Title: Samoa
Blurb: The Independent State of Western Samoa changes its name to the Independent State of Samoa.

Title: Laos and Myanmar
Blurb: Laos and Myanmar join ASEAN as the association's eighth and ninth member states.

Title: Fiji
Blurb: The Sovereign Democratic Republic of Fiji changes its name to the Republic of the Fiji Islands upon the promulgation of a new constitution. Fiji returns to its membership of the Commonwealth of Nations as a result.

Title: Anjouan
Blurb: The State of Anjouan declares independence from the Comoros. Mutsamudu becomes the capital.

Title: Moheli
Blurb: The Democratic Republic of Moheli declares independence from the Comoros. Fomboni becomes the capital.

Title: Aqmola
Blurb: Kazakhstan moves its capital from Almaty to Aqmola.

Title: Kyoto
Blurb: Concern about global warming prompted many nations to negotiate and sign the Kyoto treaty, which set mandatory limits on carbon dioxide emissions.

Title: Moheli
Blurb: Comoros reabsorbs the de facto independent Democratic Republic of Moheli. Fomboni yields to Moroni as the capital.

Title: Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium
Blurb: The United Nations Transitional Administration for Eastern Slavonia, Baranja and Western Sirmium concludes its operations and transfers full administrative authority over the region to Croatia.

Title: Astana
Blurb: Kazakhstan changes the name of its capital from Aqmola to Astana.

Title: China-Kazakhstan border
Blurb: China is allocated 407 square kilometres and Kazakhstan is allocated 537 square kilometres of disputed territory in a treaty delimiting the border between the two countries.

Title: Puntland
Blurb: The Puntland State of Somalia declares temporary independence from Somalia. Garowe becomes the capital.

Title: International Space Station
Blurb: As the century ended, a permanent crewed presence in space was being founded with the ongoing construction of the International Space Station.

Title: Southern Patagonian Ice Field
Blurb: Argentina and Chile redraw part of the border in the Southern Patagonian Ice Field, and establish a pending of definition area between Mount Fitz Roy and Cerro Murallon.

Title: Brcko District
Blurb: Self-governing Brcko District in Bosnia and Herzegovina is established.

Title: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
Blurb: The Czech Republic, Hungary, and Poland join the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in the alliance's fourth enlargement.

Title: New Caledonia
Blurb: France elevates the Overseas Territory of New Caledonia to the sui generis collectivity of New Caledonia.

Title: Collective Security Treaty Organization
Blurb: Azerbaijan, Georgia, and Uzbekistan leave the Collective Security Treaty Organization. The remaining six members renew the treaty for another 5 years.

Title: Cambodia
Blurb: Cambodia joins ASEAN as the association's tenth member state.

Title: Kosovo
Blurb: The United Nations Interim Administration Mission in Kosovo is formed in the Autonomous Province of Kosovo and Metohija of Yugoslavia.

Title: Kosovo
Blurb: The last forces of Yugoslavia withdraw from Kosovo.

Title: Ghent-Terneuzen Canal
Blurb: Belgium and the Netherlands make a small change to the border at the Ghent-Terneuzen Canal.

Title: Falun Gong
Blurb: 1999 - Falun Gong, a Chinese new religious movement dating to the early 1990s, begins to be persecuted by the Chinese government.

Title: East Timor
Blurb: Indonesia relinquishes control over the disputed region of East Timor to the United Nations Transitional Administration in East Timor.

Title: Venezuela
Blurb: The Republic of Venezuela changes its name to the Bolivarian Republic of Venezuela.

Title: China-Vietnam border
Blurb: China and Vietnam sign a treaty resolving their border dispute, with China acquiring 114 square kilometres and Vietnam acquiring 113 square kilometres of disputed territory.

Title: Panama Canal Zone
Blurb: The United States transfers the operation of the Panama Canal and full sovereignty in the former Panama Canal Zone to Panama.

Title: Chechen Republic of Ichkeria
Blurb: Six weeks after the fall of Grozny, the Chechen Republic of Ichkeria is overthrown as a state following its defeat in the Battle of Komsomolskoye; as an insurgency it continues to resist Russian rule in Chechnya for years.

Title: Southern Lebanon
Blurb: Israel completely withdraws from its occupation zone in southern Lebanon, where it is replaced by United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon peacekeeping forces.

Title: Saudi-Yemeni border
Blurb: Saudi Arabia and Yemen sign a treaty resolving their border dispute.

Title: Bogota
Blurb: Colombia returns its capital city's name from Santa Fe de Bogota back to Bogota, Distrito Capital.

Title: Taloqan
Blurb: Taloqan, the de facto capital of the Islamic State of Afghanistan, falls to the Taliban's Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan. The capital moves to Fayzabad.

Title: Hawar Islands
Blurb: The ICJ resolves the territorial dispute between Bahrain and Qatar, awarding Fasht Al Azm, Qit'at Jaradah, and most of the Hawar Islands to Bahrain, and Fasht Dibal, Zubarah, and Janan Island to Qatar.

Title: Qatar-Saudi border
Blurb: Qatar and Saudi Arabia sign a treaty resolving their border dispute.

Title: Puntland
Blurb: The temporarily independent Puntland State of Somalia adopts a new constitution explicitly identifying itself as an independent integral part of Somalia.

Title: Afghanistan
Blurb: The United States and a NATO-led alliance invade Afghanistan, beginning an occupation which continued until 2021.

Title: Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan
Blurb: The Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan is completely overthrown following its defeat in the Battle of Tora Bora. The Taliban soon reemerges as an insurgency.

Title: Bahrain
Blurb: The State of Bahrain changes its name to the Kingdom of Bahrain.

Title: Anjouan
Blurb: The Union of the Comoros reabsorbs the de facto independent State of Anjouan. Mutsamudu yields to Moroni as the capital.

Title: Timor-Leste
Blurb: The Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste gains independence with the promulgation of a constitution and the conclusion of the United Nations Transitional Administration in East Timor. Dili remains the capital.

Title: British Overseas Territories
Blurb: The United Kingdom changes the title of its British Dependent Territories to that of British Overseas Territories. The citizens of each British Overseas Territory gain full British citizenship.

Title: Serbia and Montenegro
Blurb: The Federal Republic of Yugoslavia changes its name to the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro.

Title: Iraq
Blurb: United States-led coalition forces invade Iraq, beginning an occupation which lasts for more than eight years.

Title: French Polynesia
Blurb: France reorganizes the Overseas Territory of French Polynesia as the Overseas collectivity of French Polynesia.

Title: Saint Pierre and Miquelon
Blurb: France reorganizes the Territorial collectivity of Saint Pierre and Miquelon as the Overseas collectivity of Saint Pierre and Miquelon.

Title: Wallis and Futuna
Blurb: France reorganizes the Overseas Territory of Wallis and Futuna as the Overseas collectivity of Wallis and Futuna.

Title: Tikrit
Blurb: United States forces conquer Tikrit, the last stronghold of Ba'athist Iraq.

Title: Rwanda
Blurb: The Rwandese Republic changes its name to the Republic of Rwanda.

Title: Baikonur Cosmodrome
Blurb: Kazakhstan agrees to a revision of the terms of Russia's lease of the Baikonur Cosmodrome, extending it to 2050 with no established options on further extensions.

Title: French Polynesia
Blurb: France elevates the Overseas collectivity of French Polynesia to the Overseas Country of French Polynesia.

Title: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
Blurb: Bulgaria, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Romania, Slovakia, and Slovenia join NATO in the alliance's fifth enlargement.

Title: European Union
Blurb: Ten more states join the European Union: Cyprus, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Poland, Slovakia, and Slovenia.

Title: Antarctic Treaty Secretariat
Blurb: The Antarctic Treaty Secretariat administering Antarctica and all lands and waters south of the 60th parallel south establishes its headquarters in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Title: Afghanistan
Blurb: The Islamic State of Afghanistan changes its name to the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan with the end of the transitional period set out in the new constitution.

Title: Lebanon
Blurb: Syrian troops withdraw from Lebanon, bringing an end to the Syrian occupation of Lebanon.

Title: Gaza Strip
Blurb: Israel completely withdraws its forces from the Gaza Strip. A Palestinian Civil War leads to Gaza effectively withdrawing from the Palestinian Authority and becoming a separate entity under Hamas by June 2007.

Title: Naypyidaw
Blurb: Myanmar moves its capital from Yangon to Naypyidaw.

Title: Collective Security Treaty Organization
Blurb: Uzbekistan rejoins the Collective Security Treaty Organization after previously leaving in 1999.

Title: Serbia
Blurb: The Republic of Serbia supersedes the State Union of Serbia and Montenegro. Belgrade remains the capital.

Title: Ngerulmud
Blurb: Palau moves its capital from Koror to Ngerulmud.

Title: European Union
Blurb: Bulgaria and Romania join the European Union.

Title: Nepal
Blurb: The Kingdom of Nepal changes its name to the State of Nepal.

Title: Saint Barthelemy
Blurb: France detaches the overseas collectivity of Saint Barthelemy from Guadeloupe. Gustavia becomes the capital.

Title: Scattered Islands in the Indian Ocean
Blurb: France integrates the Scattered Islands in the Indian Ocean into the French Southern and Antarctic Lands as its fifth district.

Title: Montenegro
Blurb: The Republic of Montenegro changes its name to Montenegro.

Title: Nepal
Blurb: The State of Nepal changes its name to the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal.

Title: South Ossetia
Blurb: The separatist forces of South Ossetia, supported by Russia, completely expel the forces of Georgia from the territory of the former South Ossetian Autonomous Oblast, which Georgia continues to claim in its entirety.

Title: Upper Abkhazia
Blurb: The separatist forces of Abkhazia, supported by Russia, completely expel the forces of Georgia from Upper Abkhazia, the last territory held by Georgia in the region which it continues to claim in its entirety.

Title: Bakassi
Blurb: Nigeria completes the transfer of Bakassi to Cameroon, fulfilling the terms of a 2002 ICJ ruling on the disputed territory.

Title: Abkhazia and South Ossetia
Blurb: Russia recognizes the independence of Abkhazia and South Ossetia from Georgia. Most countries continue to recognize these territories as part of Georgia.

Title: Russia-China border
Blurb: China is ceded 174 square kilometres of land by Russia as part of a treaty delimiting the borders and settling a territorial dispute between the two countries.

Title: Bolivia
Blurb: The Republic of Bolivia changes its name to the Plurinational State of Bolivia.

Title: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
Blurb: Albania and Croatia join the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in the alliance's sixth enlargement.

Title: Greenland
Blurb: Implementing the decision of a November 2008 referendum, Greenland achieves expanded home rule within the Danish Realm.

Title: Kyrgyzstan-China border
Blurb: China is ceded 9 square kilometres of land by Kyrgyzstan as part of a treaty delimiting the borders between the two countries.

Title: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
Blurb: The British Overseas Territory of Saint Helena and Dependencies changes its name to Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha. Jamestown on Saint Helena remains the capital.

Title: Rio Grande islands
Blurb: The United States cedes six uninhabited islands totaling 0.44 square kilometres in the Rio Grande river to Mexico and Mexico cedes three uninhabited islands and two bancos totaling 0.27 square kilometres after pending for 20 years.

Title: Sevastopol
Blurb: Ukraine extends Russia's lease on naval facilities in Sevastopol for an additional twenty-five years beyond the 2017 expiration, until 2042, with further renewal options thereafter.

Title: Netherlands Antilles
Blurb: The Kingdom of the Netherlands dissolves the Netherlands Antilles. Curacao (capital Willemstad) and Sint Maarten (capital Philipsburg) become constituent countries, while Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius become special municipalities of the Netherlands.

Title: Myanmar
Blurb: The Union of Myanmar changes its name to the Republic of the Union of Myanmar.

Title: Tajikistan-China border
Blurb: Tajikistan cedes 1,322 square kilometres of land to China after the final ratification of boundary treaties between the two countries.

Title: Fiji
Blurb: The Republic of the Fiji Islands changes its name back to the Republic of Fiji.

Title: Syria
Blurb: Unrest in Syria leads to the beginning of the Syrian civil war.

Title: Mayotte
Blurb: Implementing the decision of a March 2009 referendum, France incorporates the Departmental collectivity of Mayotte as the Overseas department and region of Mayotte.

Title: Sirte
Blurb: Amidst a civil war, Muammar Gaddafi moves the capital of the Libyan Arab Jamahiriya from Tripoli to Sirte, days after the rebel forces of the National Transitional Council, supported by NATO, conquered Tripoli.

Title: Libya
Blurb: Libya officially supersedes the Great Socialist People's Libyan Arab Jamahiriya, as the United Nations General Assembly seats the representatives of the National Transitional Council and recognizes the country's name change.

Title: Libyan Arab Jamahiriya
Blurb: The Libyan Arab Jamahiriya is overthrown following its defeat in the Battle of Sirte. The government of Libya declares the end of the civil war three days later.

Title: Iraq
Blurb: The United States ends its occupation of Iraq.

Title: Samoa and Tokelau
Blurb: Samoa and Tokelau switch to the western side of the International Date Line, skipping 30 December entirely.

Title: Collective Security Treaty Organization
Blurb: Uzbekistan leaves the Collective Security Treaty Organisation for a second time after rejoining the alliance in 2006.

Title: Hungary
Blurb: The Republic of Hungary changes its name to Hungary.

Title: Aguelhok
Blurb: The National Movement for the Liberation of Azawad conquers Aguelhok, the first town to fall under the control of the militant separatist group in northern Mali.

Title: Azawad
Blurb: The State of Azawad declares independence from Mali, after the MNLA conquers northern Mali's largest cities between 30 March and 2 April. Timbuktu is proclaimed the capital; Gao serves as the provisional capital.

Title: Kutaisi
Blurb: Georgia moves its legislative capital from Tbilisi to Kutaisi. Tbilisi remains the administrative capital.

Title: Scarborough Shoal
Blurb: A standoff beginning 8 April over Scarborough Shoal ends with an agreement between China and the Philippines to both withdraw their forces: only the Philippines actually does so, leaving China in effective possession.

Title: Ansongo
Blurb: Ansongo, the last town controlled by the State of Azawad, is conquered by Ansar Dine, a militant group aiming to make Mali an Islamist state which had already conquered Azawad's largest cities on 27-28 June.

Title: Somalia
Blurb: The Somali Republic changes its name to the Federal Republic of Somalia.

Title: San Andres Archipelago
Blurb: The ICJ resolves the territorial dispute between Nicaragua and Colombia, upholding Colombia's sovereignty over disputed islands while ceding Nicaragua much of the surrounding maritime territory.

Title: State of Palestine
Blurb: The United Nations General Assembly votes to upgrade the status of the State of Palestine from entity to non-member observer state, effectively granting it recognition.

Title: East China Sea
Blurb: China declares an exclusive economic zone in the East China Sea which extends hundreds of kilometers into Japan's maritime claims.

Title: State of Palestine
Blurb: After its United Nations recognition, the Palestinian National Authority changes its name to the State of Palestine. Jerusalem remains its claimed capital and Ramallah also remains its administrative center.

Title: Libya
Blurb: The General National Congress changes the provisional name of Libya to the State of Libya, pending the adoption of a new constitution.

Title: European Union
Blurb: Croatia joins the European Union.

Title: Cabo Verde
Blurb: The Republic of Cape Verde changes its official English name to the Republic of Cabo Verde, following precedents set by Cote d'Ivoire and Timor-Leste.

Title: Preah Vihear
Blurb: The ICJ clarifies its 1962 ruling on the disputed border between Cambodia and Thailand, awarding the promontory of Preah Vihear to Cambodia and Phu Ma-khuea hill to Thailand.

Title: East China Sea
Blurb: China declares an Air Defense Identification Zone over the East China Sea, around half of which overlaps with the previously declared airspace of Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan.

Title: Fallujah
Blurb: ISIS captures Fallujah in Iraq, the first significant city the militant group is able to maintain control over.

Title: Raqqa
Blurb: After having been expelled from the city by Syrian rebels early in the month, ISIS seizes total control of Raqqa, the largest city to fall under its rule in Syria.

Title: Chile-Peru maritime boundary
Blurb: The ICJ publishes a new boundary resolving the maritime dispute between Chile and Peru.

Title: Crimea
Blurb: Russia begins occupying Crimea in Ukraine.

Title: Collective Security Treaty Organization
Blurb: Serbia and Afghanistan become observer states to the Collective Security Treaty Organization.

Title: Donetsk and Luhansk
Blurb: The Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic declare independence from Ukraine following referendums. Donetsk and Luhansk become their capitals.

Title: Benghazi
Blurb: The Second Libyan Civil War begins as General Khalifa Haftar launches Operation Dignity against Islamist militias and jihadists in Benghazi, leading to a power struggle between the House of Representatives and the Government of National Accord.

Title: Mosul
Blurb: ISIS completely conquers Mosul, the second largest city in Iraq.

Title: Islamic State
Blurb: Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, the leader of the ISIS, declares the foundation of a new caliphate, the Islamic State. Raqqa is the de facto capital.

Title: Sanaa
Blurb: A civil war begins in Yemen, as Houthi insurgents take the capital of Sanaa and quickly seize control of the government.

Title: Debaltseve
Blurb: The Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic consolidate their territories with the conquest of Debaltseve from Ukraine, the last major battle of the war in Donbas.

Title: Aden
Blurb: Amidst a civil war, the Cabinet of Yemen provisionally moves the capital of Yemen to Aden, while the Supreme Political Council remains in the official capital of Sanaa.

Title: Burkina Faso-Niger border
Blurb: Burkina Faso and Niger agree to implement the ICJ's 2013 judgment on their frontier dispute case by exchanging 18 towns over the following year, with Burkina Faso to gain 14 and Niger to gain 4.

Title: India-Bangladesh enclaves
Blurb: India and Bangladesh exchange 162 enclaves, simplifying their mutual border in the region of the former Cooch Behar princely state; Bangladesh gains a net 40 square kilometres.

Title: Khmeimim Air Base
Blurb: Syria formally agrees to lease its Khmeimim Air Base to Russia with no time limit.

Title: The Gambia
Blurb: The Republic of The Gambia changes its name to the Islamic Republic of The Gambia by presidential decree.

Title: San Juan River
Blurb: The ICJ cedes 3 square kilometres to Costa Rica, resolving part of the San Juan River border dispute with Nicaragua.

Title: Rojava
Blurb: Kurdish held areas in North-eastern Syria declare the establishment of an autonomous federal government called the Democratic Federation of Rojava - Northern Syria or Rojava.

Title: Nagorno-Karabakh
Blurb: After four days of fighting, Azerbaijan reconquers 8-20 square kilometres of territory controlled by the Nagorno-Karabakh Republic since 1994.

Title: Czechia
Blurb: The Czech Republic changes its official English short-form name to Czechia.

Title: Norfolk Island
Blurb: Australia incorporates Norfolk Island within its domestic institutions and laws, implementing a March 2015 decision to revoke the territory's self-governing status.

Title: Tartus
Blurb: Syria signs a lease granting Russia sovereign jurisdiction over the naval base at the port of Tartus for 49 years, renewable for subsequent 25-year periods beginning in 2066.

Title: The Gambia
Blurb: Military forces of Senegal, Ghana, Mali, Togo, and Nigeria, members of the ECOWAS group, launch an invasion of The Gambia to enforce the results of the 2016 Gambian presidential election.

Title: The Gambia
Blurb: The Islamic Republic of The Gambia changes its name back to the Republic of The Gambia.

Title: Republic of Artsakh
Blurb: The unrecognized Nagorno-Karabakh Republic changes its name to the Republic of Artsakh after a constitutional referendum.

Title: Northern Syria Security Belt
Blurb: Turkey and the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army complete the conquest of a 2,055 square kilometre occupation zone from the Islamic State and the Syrian Democratic Forces, establishing the Northern Syria Security Belt.

Title: South Ossetia
Blurb: Following a referendum, the partially recognized Republic of South Ossetia changes its name to the Republic of South Ossetia - the State of Alania.

Title: Al-Tanf
Blurb: The United States establishes a 55 kilometre radius around Al-Tanf effectively under its control, conducting its only attack on pro-government Syrian ground forces of the Syrian civil war to prevent their advancing into the area.

Title: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
Blurb: Montenegro joins the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in the alliance's seventh enlargement.

Title: Sanafir and Tiran Islands
Blurb: Egypt transfers Sanafir Island and Tiran Island to Saudi Arabia.

Title: Catalonia
Blurb: The Generalitat of Catalonia passes a declaration of Independence from Spain which is soon suspended on 30 October of the same year.

Title: Kirkuk
Blurb: The Iraqi National Army retakes control of Kirkuk from the Kurdistan Regional Government.

Title: Meuse River
Blurb: Belgium and the Netherlands exchange territory along the Meuse River, swapping Belgian Presqu'ile de L'llal and Presqu'ile d'Eijsden for Dutch Presqu'ile Petit-Gravier; the Netherlands gains a net 0.1 square kilometres.

Title: Isla Portillos
Blurb: The ICJ awards the Laguna Los Portillos and its barrier beach to Nicaragua and the remainder of the disputed territory on Isla Portillos to Costa Rica.

Title: Afrin
Blurb: Turkey and the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army complete the conquest from the Kurdish People's Protection Units of over 2,000 square kilometres of Afrin, which is added to their Northern Syria Security Belt.

Title: Eswatini
Blurb: The Kingdom of Swaziland changes its name to the Kingdom of Eswatini.

Title: Socotra
Blurb: The United Arab Emirates occupy the Yemeni archipelago of Socotra, amidst an ongoing civil war.

Title: Socotra
Blurb: The United Arab Emirates return control of the occupied Socotra archipelago to Yemen, amidst an ongoing civil war.

Title: Badme
Blurb: Ethiopia ends its occupation of Badme and returns the town to Eritrea following a peace summit, ending their twenty-year border conflict.

Title: North and East Syria
Blurb: The Democratic Federation of Rojava - Northern Syria changes its name to the Democratic Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria.

Title: Tbilisi
Blurb: Georgia moves its legislative capital from Kutaisi back to Tbilisi.

Title: Gitega
Blurb: Burundi moves its capital from Bujumbura to Gitega.

Title: North Macedonia
Blurb: The Republic of Macedonia changes its official and constitutional name to the Republic of North Macedonia as part of the Prespa agreement, under which Greece will no longer veto the country's accession to NATO and the EU.

Title: Baghuz
Blurb: The Syrian Democratic Forces, supported by the US-led Joint Task Force and the Iraqi and Syrian governments, conquers the last territory controlled by the Islamic State in Syria or Iraq, though it continues as an insurgency.

Title: Nur-Sultan
Blurb: Kazakhstan changes the name of its capital from Astana to Nur-Sultan.

Title: Northern Syria safe zone
Blurb: Turkey and the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army complete the conquest from the predominantly-Kurdish Syrian Democratic Forces of a 4,820 square kilometre safe zone, expanding their Northern Syria Security Belt.

Title: Eastern Mediterranean
Blurb: Turkey and the Libyan Government of National Accord sign a maritime boundary treaty, establishing exclusive economic zones which are rejected by Cyprus, Egypt, France, Greece, and the United Arab Emirates.

Title: European Union
Blurb: The United Kingdom withdraws from the European Union, entering a transition period in which it continues under EU laws and institutions until 31 December.

Title: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
Blurb: North Macedonia joins the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in the alliance's eighth enlargement.

Title: Eastern Mediterranean
Blurb: Egypt and Greece sign a maritime boundary treaty, establishing exclusive economic zones in the Mediterranean Sea which overlap with the claims made by Libya and Turkey in November 2019.

Title: Nagorno-Karabakh
Blurb: Beginning of the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War between Azerbaijan, Armenia, and the disputed Republic of Artsakh.

Title: Libya
Blurb: The Second Libyan Civil War officially ends with a nationwide ceasefire agreement brokered by the United Nations between the warring factions.

Title: Nagorno-Karabakh
Blurb: Armenia and Azerbaijan impose a ceasefire ending the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War; by 15 December the Republic of Artsakh surrenders over 72% of its territory to Azerbaijan, and Russian forces are deployed to the remainder.

Title: Myanmar
Blurb: The Tatmadaw overthrows the elected government of Myanmar after baselessly alleging electoral fraud in the 2020 general election. Military rule is restored after 10 years of civilian rule, beginning mass protests and a civil war.

Title: Syunik and Gegharkunik
Blurb: Azerbaijani soldiers cross several kilometers into Armenia in the provinces of Syunik and Gegharkunik, occupying about 41 square kilometers of Armenian territory.

Title: Somalia-Kenya maritime border
Blurb: The International Court of Justice rules in favor of Somalia in its dispute with Kenya over their maritime border. Kenya does not recognize the ruling.

Title: Khor Al Adaid
Blurb: Qatar and Saudi Arabia demarcate their border, expanding Qatar's territory to include the southern shore of the Khor Al Adaid.

Title: Barbados
Blurb: Barbados becomes a republic, severing ties with the British monarchy and ceasing to be a Commonwealth realm, but still remaining a part of the Commonwealth of Nations.

Title: Andijan Reservoir
Blurb: Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan sign a border agreement, swapping the Andijan Reservoir with 13,868 hectares of Uzbek border lands.

Title: Donetsk and Luhansk
Blurb: Russia recognizes the independence of the Donetsk People's Republic and Luhansk People's Republic from Ukraine, the first UN member to do so. Most countries continue to recognize these territories as part of Ukraine.

Title: Ukraine
Blurb: Russia launches a full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

Title: Turkiye
Blurb: The Republic of Turkey changes its official English name to the Republic of Turkiye.

Title: Hans Island
Blurb: Denmark and Canada agree to partition the disputed Hans Island, following negotiations. Both sovereign states cease to be single land border sovereign states while Greenland gains its first land border.

Title: Lachin corridor
Blurb: Russian peacekeepers leave the Lachin corridor. Azerbaijan regains control of Zabukh, Sus, and Lachin.

Title: Astana
Blurb: Kazakhstan changes the name of its capital from Nur-Sultan back to Astana.

Title: Armenia-Azerbaijan border
Blurb: A series of border clashes break out between Azerbaijan and Armenia that last until 24 September. Azerbaijan occupies multiple strategic heights in the border area inside Armenia.

Title: Kherson and Zaporizhzhia
Blurb: Russia recognizes the independence of Kherson Oblast and Zaporizhzhia Oblast from Ukraine as a precursor to annexation.

Title: Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk and Luhansk
Blurb: The occupied Ukrainian territories of Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk and Luhansk Oblasts, including the mostly unrecognised Donetsk and Luhansk People's Republics, are annexed by Russia after disputed referendums the United Nations deems illegal.

Title: Israel-Lebanon maritime boundary
Blurb: Israel reaches an agreement with Lebanon on a US-brokered deal solving a dispute over their maritime boundaries.

Title: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
Blurb: Finland joins the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in the alliance's ninth enlargement.

Title: Sudan
Blurb: A civil war breaks out in Sudan between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces.

Title: Syria
Blurb: Syria is readmitted to the Arab League after being suspended since 2011.

Title: Republic of Artsakh
Blurb: The unrecognized Republic of Artsakh begins negotiations to reintegrate into Azerbaijan after a renewed military offensive.

Title: Israel
Blurb: Palestinian militant groups led by Hamas launch a large-scale invasion and offensive against Israel from the Gaza Strip, triggering the Gaza war.

Title: Gaza Strip
Blurb: Israel launches a counter-invasion of the Gaza Strip.

Title: Republic of Artsakh
Blurb: The Republic of Artsakh is dissolved and reintegrates into Azerbaijan. Stepanakert yields to Baku as the capital.

Title: North Atlantic Treaty Organization
Blurb: Sweden joins the North Atlantic Treaty Organization in the alliance's tenth enlargement.

Title: Puntland
Blurb: Puntland announces that it will temporarily operate as a functionally independent state from Somalia amid a dispute over Somali constitutional changes. Garoowe is the capital.

Title: Armenia-Azerbaijan border villages
Blurb: Armenia cedes four abandoned villages along the border with Azerbaijan: Baganis Ayrum, Asagi Askipara, Xeyrimli, and Qizilhacili.

Title: Alliance of Sahel States
Blurb: Following a series of military coups in Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, the three countries enter a confederation, forming the Alliance of Sahel States.

Title: Southern Lebanon
Blurb: Israel launches an invasion of southern Lebanon in an escalation of the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah.

Title: North Korea
Blurb: The Democratic People's Republic of Korea amends its constitution and unofficially gives up the claims to the southern part of the peninsula while de facto recognizing the existence of the Republic of Korea as a hostile state.

Title: Idlib
Blurb: Syrian opposition groups launch a major offensive, the first major offensive in the Syrian Civil War since the March 2020 Idlib ceasefire.

Title: Damascus
Blurb: The Syrian Arab Republic collapses after the Syrian opposition capture the capital city of Damascus.

Title: Syrian Golan Heights
Blurb: Israel launches an incursion into the Syrian Golan Heights, marking its first invasion into a part of Syria since the Yom Kippur War.

Title: Tort-Kocho road
Blurb: Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan agree to make the Tort-Kocho road, which connects the Tajikistani Vorukh exclave to the rest of Tajikistan, a condominium.

Title: Multinational Joint Task Force
Blurb: Niger withdraws from the Multinational Joint Task Force.

Title: Mbanie, Cocoteros and Conga
Blurb: The ICJ rules on the territorial dispute between Gabon and Equatorial Guinea, awarding Equatorial Guinea the islands of Mbanie, Cocoteros, and Conga.

Title: Zangezur corridor
Blurb: Armenia and Azerbaijan sign a peace agreement to end the Nagorno-Karabakh conflict. Included is a plan to establish the Zangezur corridor between Azerbaijan and its Nakhchivan exclave through Armenian territory, and granting the United States rights to develop the corridor.

Title: Gaza Strip
Blurb: Israel and Hamas begin a ceasefire agreement as the first stage in the Gaza peace plan.

Title: Timor-Leste
Blurb: Timor-Leste joins ASEAN as the association's eleventh member state.

Title: Southern Yemen
Blurb: The Southern Transitional Council launches an offensive against government forces in southern Yemen, capturing much of the former territory of South Yemen.

Title: Chagos Archipelago
Blurb: A group of Chagos Islanders based in the United Kingdom declare the Chagossian Government-in-Exile in support of remaining a British territory during the ongoing sovereignty dispute with Mauritius.
Place: Chagos Archipelago, British Indian Ocean Territory

Title: Somaliland
Blurb: Israel recognizes Somaliland as an independent state, becoming the first country in the world to do so, after 34 years without international recognition.

Title: Cambodia-Thailand border
Blurb: The 2025 Cambodian-Thai border crisis resolves after 7 months of on-and-off fighting, with Cambodia and Thailand each occupying disputed temples, hills, and villages along the frontier.

Title: Ciudad de la Paz
Blurb: Equatorial Guinea moves its capital from Malabo to Ciudad de la Paz.
Place: Ciudad de la Paz, Equatorial Guinea

Title: Venezuela
Blurb: The United States launches strikes on Venezuela, capturing president Nicolas Maduro and first lady Cilia Flores and bringing them to the US to face drugs and weapons charges.

Title: Southern Transitional Council
Blurb: Following a failed offensive against the Yemeni government, the Southern Transitional Council announces its dissolution.

Title: Raqqa and Deir ez-Zor Governorates
Blurb: Following an offensive against the Syrian Democratic Forces, Raqqa Governorate and Deir ez-Zor Governorate are ceded to the Syrian transitional government, and the SDF is integrated into the Syrian military. DAANES moves its capital from Ayn Issa to al-Hasakah.

Title: Ile du Coin
Blurb: A group of Chagossians organised as the Chagossian Government sail from Sri Lanka to Ile du Coin in the British Indian Ocean Territory, with the aim of establishing a permanent settlement in support of continued British rule.
Place: Peros Banhos, British Indian Ocean Territory

Title: Iran
Blurb: Israel and the United States attack Iran, starting the Iran War.

Title: Sebatik Island
Blurb: Indonesia and Malaysia complete a bilateral land boundary demarcation on Sebatik Island, with Indonesia gaining a net 122.4 hectares.

Title: Naoero
Blurb: The Republic of Nauru changes its official English name to the Republic of Naoero.
